scope: Explicit test observation paths for already-required X-owned channel/slot/checkpoint responsibilities; original schema1 response untouched.
ordinary_response: Keep original X {binding,result,artifacts}; Node binding adds original Session/profile/slot/channel fields. Existing X artifact fullref remains {path,sha256,size,...scope}, S file references use {path,sha256,bytes}; conversion is test read-only mapping of size, never a new hash identity.

channel_read.meaning: Original bytes at explicit cursor, no destructive hidden read counter; same call_id exact retry returns original range. All fields compared to independent actual stream original and call body.

channel_write.meaning: Original call record references actual issued/partial/confirmed result. Absence of an ACK cannot be replaced by successful bridge cache.

call_ref: Actual immutable file ref {path,sha256,size} of original X call receipt representation. query_call returns same original ref/body rather than writing a new equivalent call. Existing record revisions may have different refs; original issued and dispatch evidence retained.

call_record.meaning: Complete method-content/range association. For read, data digest/bytes bind returned bytes. For write, digest/bytes bind full requested original bytes and written_bytes reflects known prefix. UNKNOWN/ISSUED no automatic remainder/re-dispatch.

slot_record_ref: Original query exposes artifacts.slot as actual file ref or immutable exported read snapshot of original authoritative slot record. Inspection is observational; raw store/transaction evidence at real pre-create/pre-write barriers must independently substantiate original state.

slot_record.meaning: Exact original registered plan and X-owned durable reservations. Unknown retains reservation. Actual physical objects and original files are independently inventoried; declared totals never sufficient.

failure_injection: Trusted test_context.requested_barrier hooks only at real existing responsibility/write boundaries; driver checks actual corresponding raw state or prefix before killing original process. Missing or prematurely signaled barrier is invalid evidence.
